purpose: Independent checks by the dispatching session of the two load-bearing claims in the 7-round MINI-AES-64 result: the MDS contradiction against a prior task, and the degree argument that decides whether the result transfers to AES-128.
verified_by: dispatching session (Bash) - coordinator-side corroboration, NOT independent validation under 0137a051

check_1_MDS_contradiction.the_conflict: A prior GOAL-AES-001 task recorded that the AES-shaped MixColumns row (02,03,01,01) is not usable over GF(2^4) and substituted (5,2,1,1). The 7-round task checked it, found the opposite, and kept the AES-shaped row. One of the two had to be wrong.
check_1_MDS_contradiction.my_check: Exhaustive determinant over all square submatrices of the circulant, over GF(2^4) mod x^4+x+1 = 0x13.
check_1_MDS_contradiction.verdict: THE 7-ROUND TASK IS RIGHT. The AES-shaped row IS MDS over this field, and the prior task's substitute is NOT. The earlier substitution was unnecessary and the substituted matrix was strictly worse. Neither committed record is edited; this is the correction of record.
check_1_MDS_contradiction.caveat: Field representation matters. This is GF(2^4) mod 0x13. A different irreducible polynomial could change the answer, and the prior task may have used one - I did not check which.

check_2_the_degree_argument_that_limits_.why_it_matters: This decides whether a 7-round certified recovery on the analogue says anything about AES-128. The 7-round task stated the limit FIRST, before its result, and said the 5-round balance is a 4-bit-cell artifact. I checked that claim rather than accepting it.
check_2_the_degree_argument_that_limits_.my_check: Built the GF(2^4) inversion S-box with its affine layer and measured its algebraic degree directly by Moebius transform over all four output-bit ANFs.

measured.consequence: the integral survives three rounds, so the 5-round balance EXISTS on the analogue

aes_128_comparison.consequence: NO chosen-plaintext set inside a 128-bit block can supply the dimension the argument needs, at ANY data complexity

check_2_the_degree_argument_that_limits_.verdict: CONFIRMED, and it is decisive. The 5-round balance is a 4-bit-cell artifact. The 7-round certified recovery DOES NOT TRANSFER to AES-128, exactly as the producing task stated before reporting its result. This is the honest reason 7 rounds executes on the analogue and was measured out of reach at full scale.

what_the_scaled_result_establishes: A certified 7-round key recovery on MINI-AES-64 over its full unrestricted 2^64 key space, replicated on two independently random keys, at 235.7 s measured against a modelled ~3320 years for exhaustive search on the same cipher. What transfers is structural: the two-round bottom extension shape, the partial-sums fold, the guess-space accounting, and the finding that the distinguisher level rather than the peel sets reachable depth.
what_it_does_NOT_establish: Anything whatsoever about AES-128 at 7 rounds. The distinguisher it rests on provably cannot exist there.
Any full-round claim, on any cipher.
Novelty - the integral/square family and partial sums are standard, and under the symmetric prohibition that recollection may be used neither to promote nor to dismiss this.
Any comparison against published cryptanalysis, which remains unadjudicable here in both directions.
